notes:
Lead from inbound signup; small e-comm SaaS (headless storefront + knowledge base). Founder/CTO (Maya Singh) is technical — wants examples not hand-holding. Primary ask: integration help for LangChain and LlamaIndex, and an example Next.js/Vercel AI SDK quickstart that uses Redwood Hosted API for embeddings + generation.

What they tried: deployed a Next.js preview on Vercel, wired Vercel AI SDK to Redwood key, used langchain-js retriever with a Redis vector placeholder. Ran into issues: embedding dimensionality mismatch (LangChain expecting 1536, model returned 1280), and stream connection timeouts on edge functions. SE notes: likely using wrong model profile and not setting chunking / prefix caching.

CTO quote: 'If you can give us a lightweight repo we can fork and be live in a day, we'll convert — we care about latency and predictable cost.'

Latency/throughput targets: median <200ms for single-turn chat, bursts to 25 req/s for peak merchandising events. Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to optimize batching/caching to reduce token spend.

Model preferences: open/verified models (7B-13B quantized) for generation; embeddings compatible with LangChain (1536). Wants routing fallback to cheaper model during high load.

Security: requires SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs retention 12 months, and option to pin data region (US). Started security review; asked for SOC2 + data residency statements.

POC milestones: create forkable quickstart repo (LangChain + LlamaIndex examples) -> deploy to Vercel preview -> validate median latency and embedding dims -> finalize pilot by Apr.
